comparisonPlan.method: fit to 7:4 at 1440 tall, Lanczos downsample, pad 20 px each side, SAR1; never stretch/crop
comparisonPlan.baseline: Original uses same assumed color transform, Lanczos geometry and final codec for display; retain original MP4 too
comparisonPlan.currentWorker: Benchmark-only native streaming path plus isolated-harness normalization; ordinary worker defaults preserved
comparisonPlan.encodePlan: Native existing libx264 CRF18; normalized delivery CRF18 same preset/thread cap for all; document second-encode bias, use native crops for model detail and optionally lossless native CRF0 only with separate CPU/disk budget approval
temporalReview: Normal-speed review first, slow playback second; no still-frame-only winner
comparisonPlan.metricRule: No HR ground truth; SSIM/LPIPS/frame-differences/frequency only support human review; learned metrics also need resource approval
comparisonPlan.runs: One approved run/candidate, no prompt, no regeneration, no warmup or automatic retry; OOM/failure final unless user approves a change

audio.planned: Copy source AAC into native and normalized outputs; no generation/re-encode, do not use -shortest because original audio is 17ms longer
audio.currentAudioPreservedFlag: Stream existence plus copy mode only, not byte-level proof

color.currentDecode: Implicit ffmpeg YUV -> RGB24; no explicit input matrix/range/transfer
color.currentEncode: RGB full -> limited BT.709 YUV420P, tags bt709
color.proposal: Choose/log common SDR BT.709 limited input assumption for this untagged H264; explicit decode to RGB full [0,1], explicit final limited BT709 encode; no gamma/contrast/denoise changes
color.hdr10bitAlpha: Not supported by current 8bit video pipeline

resourcePlan.gpuFallback: Explicit CUDA requested; CPU EP may be registered implicitly by ORT but CPU graph assignment prohibited; fallback disabled before first constructor load and at runtime; completed provider profile must be exclusively CUDA
telemetryLater: ORT external GPU polling with WDDM limits
resourcePlan.expectedPeaks: unknown; buffers/weight size do not establish activation peak or encoder total RSS
resourcePlan.recovery: Stop on OOM; no tile retry, CPU fallback or second model without approved plan

resourceControlPreparation.launchPolicy: Default plan-only. --execute requires matching --approve-candidate after separate human authorization. Never loop over candidates with --execute.

locks.global: controlled/active.lock exclusive create; no automatic stale recovery

locks.worker: exactly one pinned job/lifetime including failures; image jobs disabled
locks.cleanupFailure: retain active.lock if owned process exit cannot be verified

resourceControlPreparation.isolation: Fresh private-token localhost one-worker process/candidate; Windows Job Object affinity/kill-on-close; caches discarded by process exit before normalization; no foreign process termination

gpu.allocationCaveat: System use/free is not model allocation; torch peaks do not represent ORT; process/context exit checked, system VRAM delta not attributable under WDDM
gpu.ortConstructorNoRetry: Reviewed ORT 1.22.0 subclass disables fallback before first session load; other versions fail closed; implicitly registered CPU EP permitted, CPU graph execution prohibited

guards.configuration: LOCAL_VIDEO_BENCHMARK_* env; finite positive thresholds; no automatic reductions
